Nature.title: Some Jurassic period birds were flightless
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02645-8

The fossil discovery of an early avian ancestor in China reveals that flightless birds lived alongside the known flying species.
